description: A dermatologist-inspired morning skincare routine designed to help manage oily skin and maintain a healthy complexion.

morning_steps.action: Cleansing with a gentle facial cleanser
morning_steps.purpose: To remove impurities and excess oil from the skin without stripping natural oils.

morning_steps.action: Toning to balance pH levels and tighten pores
morning_steps.purpose: To refine texture and minimize the appearance of pores, preparing the skin for subsequent products.

morning_steps.action: Applying a lightweight moisturizer suitable for oily skin
morning_steps.purpose: To hydrate the skin and provide a barrier against external irritants while managing sebum production.
To shield the skin from harmful UV rays and prevent sun damage, which can exacerbate oily skin conditions.

do: Apply sunscreen daily, even on cloudy days.
dont: Skip exfoliation too often; use it once or twice weekly only if needed and with caution to avoid irritation.
Over-wash your face, as this can irritate the skin and increase oil production.
common_mistakes: Using heavy, greasy moisturizers that can clog pores in oily skin types.
Neglecting to cleanse thoroughly before applying makeup or SPF.

expected_results.2_weeks: Reduction in oiliness and improved skin texture.
expected_results.1_month: Softer, smoother, and less congested skin with enhanced radiance.
expected_results.3_months: Significantly reduced appearance of pores and fewer breakouts.

expert_tips: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water throughout the day to support overall skin health.
Eat a balanced diet rich in antioxidants and healthy fats, which can positively affect your skin's condition.
